title: [GMCP 203.021.02] Production path: Local MCP gateway, reverse proxy, and aggregation plane
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-021-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: GMCP exposes many local or remote servers as one policy-enforced endpoint while preserving original server identity, capabilities, schemas, errors, progress, cancellation, subscriptions and trace context. Routing and transformation are deterministic; backpressure, quotas and failure isolation prevent one backend from harming others; and direct-versus-gateway differential tests prove no semantic loss. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
